Property.name: %ActionHint
Property.Description: Subclasses can store hint values here for use in determining what ReplyCodeAction to apply

Property.name: FailureTimeout
Property.Description:
How long to keep retrying before giving up and returning an error code.
-1 means never give up.

Property.name: RetryInterval
Property.Description: How frequently to retry access to the output system

Property.name: Retry
Property.Description: Set this property to 1 if you want to retry the current message again
